---
title: "quarto-shapes"
subtitle: "CSS shape classes for Quarto documents and presentations"
---

Style divs as shapes that can contain text and other elements. Supports fill, stroke, rotation, and sizing — all composable as classes.

## Installation

```bash
quarto add emilhvitfeldt/quarto-shapes
```

## Quick Start

Add to your YAML front matter:

```yaml
---
title: My Document
format: html
filters:
  - shapes
---
```

Then wrap any content in a shape div:

```markdown
::: {.shape-circle .shape-fill-blue}
Hello
:::
```

## Typst / PDF output

Shapes also render in Quarto's `typst` format (PDF).
The existing SVG definitions are embedded as Typst images, so every shape is available.
Note these print-specific behaviors.

- Size classes map to print lengths: `.shape-sm` 3cm, `.shape-md` 5cm, `.shape-lg` 8cm.
- Content is centered within the shape's bounding box, not its visual outline.
